book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: At night, we heard the sound of heavy feet.

sentences.ar: فات علينا عملاق طوله زي نخلة.
sentences.en: A giant as tall as a palm tree came in on us.
He had one eye in the middle of his face.

sentences.ar: تطلع فينا ومسك أكبر واحد فينا.
sentences.en: He looked at us and grabbed the biggest of us.

sentences.ar: ما بحب أحكي شو صار بعدها.
sentences.en: I do not like to say what happened after that.
We stayed afraid until the end of the night.
In the morning he went out and left the door open.
